nodes.label: Single-Flight Token Refresh
nodes.rationale: The dashboard fires several queries at once; without coalescing each would POST /auth/refresh and rotate the refresh token out from under the others, invalidating the session they were trying to save.

nodes.label: Cookie-Presence Edge Auth Gate
nodes.rationale: The Edge runtime cannot cheaply verify a JWT, and an expired access token is still a live session because the API layer refreshes it transparently; so the cookie is only a 'session may exist' hint and the real decision happens client-side after Redux hydrates.

nodes.label: accessToken -> token Response Normalization
nodes.rationale: Backend returns `accessToken`; the frontend normalizes to `token` for consistency, and persistence is deliberately left to authSlice's setCredentials because two writers made the cookie and localStorage state drift apart.

nodes.label: Dual API Layers: RTK Query vs Class Services
nodes.rationale: Migration to Redux/RTK Query is incomplete, so legacy BaseApiService subclasses coexist with injectEndpoints slices and need manual token fan-out.
